Part of #27377 (the 18.3.0 sweep anchor; wave 5, card W5-FAIL)

QA run record for the 18.3.0 pre-cut re-check, wave 5 card W5-FAIL: every item wave 4 judged FAIL (20 items) re-judged **live and in full** (every acceptance and negative clause, not only the failed ones) at one subject, plus the two release blockers: `records-forms.list-view-capabilities` A8 (#29173) and the #29015 path as an off-clause re-check. Item verdicts are derived from clause verdicts, never hand-assigned. Run under `.claude/skills/checklist-test/SKILL.md` and `docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md`; a QA run, not a lane card. Warren dispatched the four wave-5 cards on 2026-11-03 08:21Z.

**Result: 20/20 judged · 15 PASS / 0 PARTIAL / 5 FAIL / 0 BLOCKED / 0 NOT-RUN.** No item is `planned`. 181 clause rows, all driven live: 169 pass, 12 fail. Wave 4 had all 20 at FAIL; 15 move to PASS. Of the 5 still failing, 2 are stale spec (one carried by an open card, one carded now) and 3 are product defects (one is the same clause still failing after its fix, two are new rows or surfaces). Blockers: **#29173 A8 PASS**; **#29015 re-check FAIL** (the fix is incomplete, confirmed by an independent verify pass, carded). One off-clause security finding was reported privately to the dispatching PM session (one line below).

## Environment fingerprint

- Framework: `objectstack-ai/objectstack` @ `589049b023d82c94508bf9fce752ea19069279e5` (main, the merge of #29790), detached; it never followed `main` or the Version PR #26517. `ui/` is the same commit; the Console was built in-repo from it.
- CI on the subject: push run 41600797636 (CI) re-read before posting: `completed / success`.
- Build: `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` (30 s), `pnpm exec turbo run build --concurrency=2` (118/118 tasks, exit 0, 15m13s), `pnpm console:build` (71/72 cached plus the copy). `check-dev-prereqs`: 106 build artifacts present. Node v22.23.4, pnpm 10.31.0, Playwright Chromium 1243 from `/opt/pw-browsers`, 4 CPUs, ~15 GiB.
- Boot, one or more per runner: a scratch copy of `examples/app-showcase` (tar without `node_modules` and `.objectstack`, `node_modules` symlinked), started from the copy with `OS_PORT=PORT OS_HOME=RUN/home OS_STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT=RUN/uploads setsid node packages/cli/bin/run.js dev --ui --seed-admin --no-watch -p PORT -d file:RUN/data.db`. A canary boot answered `/api/v1/health` 200 in 16 s and served `/_console/` 200 before any runner started. Ports 41710–41819. Seed: `--seed-admin` (admin@objectos.ai), the stock showcase seed and demo personas; members minted by invite + sign-up or admin create-user + change-password, each persona's identity proved server-side before its cells.
- Execution: 8 item runners + 2 blocker runners + 1 independent verify runner (Agent subagents, opus, effort high), at most 3 browser scripts at once (flock semaphore) and at most 2 vitest pins at once (`--maxWorkers=1`). Chromium was OOM-killed a few times under the 8-boot load; every affected run was repeated, none is scored on a crashed page.
- Hygiene: the tree stayed clean (`git status` empty), `examples/app-showcase/.objectstack` does not exist, no listener remains on any run port.
- Time: setup 08:25–08:42Z (17 min, build-bound); testing 08:42–09:57Z (75 min wall, ~420 runner-minutes); probes 160 runner-minutes inside that.

## Reproduction rule for every `fail`

R-1 · `ai.mcp-run-action-exposure-gate` · A4 · stale spec (2/2 fresh boots)
1. Stock boot. As admin (session): `POST /api/v1/keys {"name":"k"}` → key K.
2. MCP Streamable HTTP `POST /api/v1/mcp`, `Authorization: Bearer K`: `initialize`, `notifications/initialized`.
3. `tools/call list_actions {}`. Clause expects 0 `sys_*` actions; actual `totalCount` 37, 36 `sys_*`, all `aiExposed: true`, all `unavailable` for an osk_ caller.
4. `run_action {"actionName":"create_api_key","objectName":"sys_api_key","params":{"name":"x"}}`. Clause expects 'Object "sys_api_key" is a system object and its actions are not exposed via MCP'; actual 'Action "create_api_key" on system object "sys_api_key" is not exposed via MCP: …'. Without objectName, likewise a new spelling.
5. With the admin's session bearer, `run_action revoke_api_key` (`confirm: true`) → `ok: true`, key `revoked: true`. Clause expects a wholesale refusal.
Rulings: 6513869839 (#27681), 6523087116 (#27900), amended by 6540309323. Code: `systemObjectActionExposureError` (packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts), `isListableAction` (packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts).

R-2 · `integration-system.email-template-render` · A7 · product defect (2 fresh boots, 3 runs; dist equals source)
1. Stock boot, admin bearer.
2. `POST /api/v1/email/send` `{"to":{"address":"ok@example.com","name":42},"subject":"x","text":"x"}`.
Expected 400 VALIDATION_FAILED naming the display name; actual 500 `{"code":"EMAIL_SEND_FAILED","error":"a.name?.trim is not a function"}` (log: `rawAddressText … recordRejectedMessage`). Same for `cc` name 42, `replyTo` name true, a `to` list entry with an object name. Every other A7 bound holds (200 admin; 401 anonymous; 400 non-object body; 403 member, foreign from, sentBy, bad headers, other organizationId, identityMail; malformed address strings 400 since #29250).

R-3 · `studio-authoring.expression-editors` · A2, A4, A6, N0 · stale spec against the #26858 ruling (3/3 fresh loads)
1. Stock boot, admin form sign-in; a permission set on an object with a virtual formula field `f_formula`.
2. Studio › Access › RLS, type the USING `record.f_formula > 5`.
Clause expects the editor to refuse and hold with no PUT; actual "Valid CEL" for ~1.6 s, autosave `PUT` 200, then the error after the server re-read; editing to `> 7` PUTs again; the engine refuses the text at publish (422 `rls-predicate-unenforceable`). This is the #27612 design (held once the server verdict on that text is read back); the #26858 ruling forbids a client copy of the publish rule. Owner: open #27482 (a ruling: re-point to "held from the server re-read on", or keep "no PUT" and fund a validate-only door). Control: the same fill holds the other probe tiers with 0 PUTs.

R-4 · `studio-authoring.no-entry-property-matrix` · A1, A2, N0 (the `field.sortable` row) · product defect (4/4 fresh loads)
1. Writable package, object `qar8_fz` with `nosort: {type:'text', sortable:false}`, published, a few rows.
2. `GET /api/v1/meta/object/qar8_fz` → `fields.nosort.sortable: false`; served sortability projection → `fields.nosort = {sortable:true}`.
3. `GET /api/v1/data/qar8_fz?sort=nosort` → 200.
4. Console list (default tab and an explicit-columns view): click the "No Sort" header → request `sort=nosort`; the Sort picker offers "No Sort".
Expected: not sortable in list views (`field.zod.ts`, liveness grade "grid"); actual: sortable everywhere. Control: the Name header sends `sort=name`.

R-5 · `ux-conventions.disabled-control-reason` · A0, A1, A2 · product defect (3/3 and 2/2 fresh loads)
1. Stock boot, admin form sign-in.
2. Open `/_console/studio/~all/metadata/object/showcase_task` or `/_console/studio/~all/metadata/flow/showcase_task_completed` (banner: "This item is locked and cannot be edited or deleted.").
3. With nothing selected, the Properties panel's controls are disabled (object: Name, Label, Plural label, Icon, Description, Exposure posture, Required capabilities; flow: `button#mdf-type`).
Expected: tooltip on hover, a Tab-reachable wrapper with `aria-describedby` carrying the reason; actual: none of the three. Control: a writable item renders the panel enabled; the node inspector on the same page explains itself since #29203.

## Release blockers

- **#29173 · `records-forms.list-view-capabilities` A8: PASS** (two runners independently, 2 + 1 fresh boots). Recalculate Selection over 3 rows on `showcase_task` › Bulk Actions sends ONE `POST /api/v1/actions/showcase_task/showcase_recalc_selection {"params":{"_selectedIds":[3 ids]}}` → 200; dialog "Succeeded 3 / 3"; the 3 rows' `estimate_hours` change server-side, the other 7 do not. Mark Done over 2 rows = 2 per-record POSTs 200. Forged POST 200. Gate both sides: a member without task edit is refused, with `showcase_contributor` allowed.
- **#29015 re-check (off-clause, under `studio-authoring.api-written-keys-survive-studio-save`): FAIL**, independently verified (RUNNER rule 7). R-6:
  1. Writable package PKG, published dashboard D (one metric widget), an app whose nav names D.
  2. As admin (no set grants `showcase.export_data`): `PUT /api/v1/meta/dashboard/D?mode=draft&package=PKG` with the published body + `"requiredPermissions":["showcase.export_data"]` → 200. Draft read: admin 403, an entitled reader 200 with the key.
  3. Fresh browser, form sign-in as admin, open `/_console/studio/PKG/interfaces` (or the metadata deep link): #29132's refusal strip shows, and under it an editable `{}` buffer (Properties inspector, item tools; Source reads `{}`) on 10 of 11 loads (first runner 7 of 9).
  4. Source tool: replace `{}` with the published body → autosave `PUT …?mode=draft&package=PKG&surface=studio`, no If-Match → 200; the reader's draft has no `requiredPermissions`, its draft-only label is gone, admin's read flips 403→200 (2/2 per runner). An inspector-only edit sends `{"label":…}` → 422 (the inspector cannot supply `name`).
  Mechanism: dynamic preview registration makes the first render non-editable; the `!isEditable` arm installs `draft={}` for the leaf; the later 403 branch (`StudioDesignSurface.tsx` ~L5284–5290) never clears it. The list-view editor (#29275) holds (no buffer, no PUT, 2/2). Not a security finding (the author holds metadata write on the package). Card in the close-out.

## Off-clause probes (RULE 8)

160 runner-minutes over all 20 items (2–10 min each), as admin, members, demo personas and anonymous; boundary classes empty string, missing/unknown id, wrong type, posture opposites (osk_ vs session bearer; member vs admin) and readers outside the asserted scope. Findings that passed the filing gate are extracted (close-out): the per-object batch door's row code for an undeclared hook refusal (beside `api-backend.error-sentences-and-unique-violation-wire-code`) and a mis-cased `sys_user.locale` (beside `i18n.notification-localized-and-clears`). Kept in notes, not carded: the clone refusal "is not shipped by a package" for a copy already in the `.custom` pair (wording only, the refusal is right); the send door keeping a CRLF subject while refusing multi-line custom headers (admin-only door, transports fold header line breaks; hardening note); the send door accepting unknown body keys; a member reaching the Setup Applications page by typed URL (UI-only, server refuses the writes, same family as #28988 and parked upstream as objectui#12706).

- `records-forms.adhoc-filter-sort-builder` · observed beside the clauses · security finding — detail withheld, reported to PM

- RUNNER environment fact "`view` is overlay-allowed, a view PUT answers 2xx on stock showcase with no `?package=`" no longer holds (ADR-0146 D11): a bare view/email_template PUT answers 403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE; the working recipe is `POST /packages/com.example.showcase/ensure-customization`, then PUT `?package=com.example.showcase.custom` with `overrides:{package,basedOn}`. Affects list-view N0/N1 staging and email-template-render's admin-edit steps.
